data.content:
## [Stylish area rug that brightens up my living room!](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/647ccf99706f837cb1f7d571)
I've been looking for a new living room area rug, because the one I have now is rather non-descript. L&G has a wide selection of bold, stylish designs, and I was able to easily find one I liked! The ordering process was very straightforward, and I received frequent updates on the delivery status, which was fairly quick considering today's supply chain issues. The rug enhances my living room beautifully, and I've received several compliments! I'd rate the quality 4/5 - it's not a top-of-the-line item, but for the price I paid, I'm not surprised or disappointed. My only minor complaint ... the rug was fairly dusty when I unpacked it, and I cleaned it thoroughly with a mild, non-chemical product before I put it down on the floor (which I think is a good thing to do with any rug you order from anywhere!). Also, the company barrages you with email and text ads, which gets annoying after a while. Overall, though, I'm very pleased!

June 2, 2023
